consequence.statement: Tracking switches to annotation-based; labels are replaced with annotations on the next sync, and in a known edge case (a resource deleted in the first sync after switching) resources may be orphaned.
consequence.remediation: Verify tracking after upgrade, or set application.resourceTrackingMethod explicitly to label to keep prior behavior.

assertion.statement: The default resource tracking method in argocd-cm (application.resourceTrackingMethod) changes from label to annotation in Argo CD 3.0; labels are replaced with annotations on next sync.
